lines.open: R-One, Tide Control. Twenty minutes of slack water left.
lines.crew: Tether's laid out, plenty of slack. Fly easy.
lines.task: Shoot the leg C anode first. Dead ahead of you.
lines.nudgeMove: R-One, push forward a little. The anode's right in front of you.
lines.nudgePhoto: Close to about two metres. One shot is all we need.
lines.praise: Clean. You can read the anode wastage clearly.
lines.praiseFar: Got it. Get closer next time.
lines.skipPhoto: Leave the photo for now. Move on to leg B.
lines.toLegB: Good. North along the west face to leg B. Hold your depth.
lines.nudgeLegB: R-One, leg B is north of you. Turn and go.
lines.stop: Stop! Do you know your way out?
lines.backOut: Don't pull. Back out the way you came — south, past the anode.
lines.dontPull: Still pulling! {n} newtons, don't force it!
lines.slipped: ...It slid off by itself. The tether's free.
lines.lucky: That was luck. Next time, know your way out first. Remember how that felt.
lines.stuck: Hold there. We'll pay out and clear it at slack water.
lines.noSnag: Right, that's it for now. Leg B on the next dive.
lines.lost: Nobody's hurt. The vehicle has a beacon; we'll get it back. Remember how that felt.

location: Offshore wind farm · Jacket leg C
